page.content:
Emperor who asked the west for help and opened the First Crusade.

How Alexios I Komnenos connects

  • Topic: Byzantine Empire — Alexios I restored the state after Manzikert and met the First Crusade.
  • Event: Battle of Manzikert — Manzikert's aftermath is what Alexios I had to repair.

What is Alexios I Komnenos?

Alexios I Komnenos (r. 1081–1118) restored the army after Manzikert, appealed to the papacy for mercenaries, and instead received the First Crusade through his capital.

Key threads lead to Byzantine Empire and Battle of Manzikert.
